description: Eight user levels with per-level UserLevelProfile (default_explanations, level_of_detail, warnings_caveats, ui_complexity in minimal/moderate/full, teaching_windows, suggested_next_action, what_not_to_hide, what_not_to_over_explain, proof_status_visible, authority_gates_active, teaching_window_explains_blocked_reason). build_record() refuses any model that: (1) is missing a required level; (2) declares any level with proof_status_visible=False -> BLOCKED_PROOF_HIDDEN; (3) declares any level with authority_gates_active=False -> BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_BYPASS; (4) declares any level with teaching_window_explains_blocked_reason=False -> BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_BYPASS; (5) declares any level whose what_not_to_hide list does not mention 'training' and 'false' -> BLOCKED_PROOF_HIDDEN.
